classes.as_of: start-2025 (end-2024); published 29 Sep 2025. No 2026 edition found
classes.label: Real estate
classes.method_note: Savills modelled world real estate (residential, commercial, farmland). Start-2025 value for end-2024. No 2026 edition found. Manual anchor. Not extrapolated.

classes.label: Debt securities
classes.method_note: SIFMA Capital Markets Fact Book 2026, global fixed income outstanding for 2025. Manual anchor.

classes.label: Listed equities
classes.method_note: Anchor 157.8 as of 2025-12-31 scaled by VT 110.0 / 100 on 2026-10-16. Share-count change is ignored (about 1% a year). SIFMA fact book listed-equity market cap for 2025. WFE cross-check was $151.94T at end-2025. Share-count change between anchors is ignored when a proxy price is applied.
classes.methodology_break: Scaled from the reported SIFMA anchor. Snapshot 0 is the unscaled reported figure.

classes.label: Broad money
classes.method_note: Sum of m2index value_usd across economies with a USD conversion. Attribute M2 Index, m2index.com, with the observation date. Rows used 2, blank USD skipped 1, oldest period 2026-06. Fed H.6 M2 23342.8 billion USD as of 2026-08 ECB M3 17646463 UNIT_MULT 6 EUR as of 2026-08 World Bank equity cap cross-check 141297217290000 USD as of 2025
classes.methodology_break: Headline is the summed CSV, not the hand-compiled 144.4 figure in snapshot 0.

classes.label: Gold
classes.method_note: tonnes 222600 as of 2026-06-30 × 32150.7466 oz/t × spot 4000.0. PAXG-USD 4010.0 price_check ok. Primary spot is used. World Gold Council above-ground stock, end-Q2 2026. WGC's own USD figure was $29.0T.
classes.methodology_break: Price source changed from the London fix used in snapshot 0 to the spot feed.

classes.label: Private markets
classes.method_note: PitchBook private-market AUM forecast, May 2026, $20.3T. Page timed out on 2026-10-17; figure is the snapshot 0 anchor. Range cross-checks: CFA Institute about $18T (Sep 2025), Preqin $19.3T. Manual anchor.

classes.label: Art and collectibles
classes.method_note: Deloitte Art & Finance Report 2023. $2.17T in 2022, $2.86T as a 2026 projection. Ultra-HNW holdings only. Manual anchor. Not extrapolated beyond the published projection.
classes.methodology_break: ultra-HNW holdings only; 2026 figure is a projection from a 2022 base

classes.label: Bitcoin
classes.method_note: spot 80000.0 × issued supply 20099709.375 from tip height 971907. Supply sums the first `height` block subsidies (heights 0 through height-1) and does not include the subsidy of the block at `height`. Lost coins are not deducted. Bitcoin ETF holdings are a small overlap with listed equities and are not removed.
classes.methodology_break: Snapshot 0 used a CoinMarketCap price and a rounded 20.10M supply, not this height rule.

classes.label: Other crypto
classes.method_note: Snapshot 0 other crypto is CoinMarketCap total minus BTC on 16 Oct 2026, including about $183B USDT and $73B USDC. CoinGecko live pull is demoted because robots.txt disallows /api/v3. Manual anchor. Live CoinGecko pull is off: robots.txt Disallow /api/v3 for User-agent *; demoted to manual anchor.
